title: Measure the existing test suite as the HW2 evaluation baseline
description: User request on 2026-11-03: evaluate the existing agent-generated HW1 test suite for HW2 Part 2, especially current code coverage. Preserve the initial suite and distinguish measured results from environmental limits.
acceptance_criteria: Given the unchanged application and tests at b40405b, when coverage instrumentation runs, then report line and branch coverage with the source denominator and exclusions.
Given tests that require PostgreSQL, Redis and MinIO, when Docker is unavailable, then report those tests as unmeasured rather than presenting unit coverage as full backend coverage.
Given the HW2 assignment, when reporting the baseline, then distinguish coverage from test correctness and fault detection and preserve execution evidence for later improvement rounds.
verification: Baseline at b40405b, application/tests/manifests/lockfiles unchanged. Final Docker pytest run in ara-hw2-test: 1228 passed, no skips, 296.46 s. Ruff passed in the first full run on the same source; the final runner reused that prepared stack and did not repeat Ruff (corrected 2026-11-08 after an independent rerun, in which Ruff also passed). Coverage.py 7.17.1 with the C tracer, thread/greenlet/multiprocessing/subprocess collection and greenlet 3.5.6 in the temporary uv overlay: 8584/9050 lines (94.85%), 2011/2378 branches (84.57%); child data verified and diagnostic probes excluded. Frontend Vitest 5.0.3 plus V8 provider 5.0.3: 766 tests across 94 files passed in 42.25 s; 3184/3322 lines (95.84%), 3474/3968 branches (87.55%). Infrastructure: 46 tests OK in 9.878 s. The baseline note and journal record Docker permissions, host tokenizer cache, temporary npm dependency resolution, missing greenlet tracing and child bootstrap failure, with retained local evidence and corrected checks. Playwright and live-provider checks were not run. Correctness review is sampled; no new application bug detected and no HW2 improvement round performed. Findings saved locally on feat/ara-115-hw2-coverage. Local integration checks: 46 infrastructure tests passed in 7.754 s on the merged tree; agent guides identical; application and test sources unchanged from b40405b. Generated evidence copied into the main checkout’s ignored evidence directory. Local merge only, per user instruction.
